title: Polka Portals prompt front matter
description: Front matter at the top of every prompt file (YAML subset: key: value, key: [a, b], or key: followed by '  - item' lines). Validated by 80_TOOLS/index-prompts.py.

id.description: Stable id, never reused. PP-IMG-HERO-001, PP-UI-BUILD-001, PP-AUD-CANON-001, PP-NEG-GLOBAL-001.

subcategory.description: Folder under image-gen (hero-phantom, backgrounds, textures, hud-overlays, thumbnails, album-art) or a short label.

targets.description: Tools the prompt is written for: midjourney, openai-image, adobe-firefly, stable-diffusion, flux, ideogram, claude, codex, cursor, any-llm, any-image.

output.description: What a good result is: format, size, background.

variables.description: Names of {{VARIABLES}} in the prompt body.

canon_refs.description: Canon files the prompt depends on (paths from the canon root). Checked for existence.

negative_refs.description: Negative lists to append (paths from the canon root). Checked for existence.
